finding.detail: The parity harness compares ACE's single-label keyword prediction with the taxonomy's primary label OR its general fallback. Taxonomy confidence is below its primary-label threshold for all six rows, so general means no taxonomy class was admitted, not an affirmative general-domain label. The harness also feeds entire source files as summary text and does not compare a reviewed common-label target.
finding.decision: Do not treat these six rows as ground-truth label disagreements. Preserve PARITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; do not redirect callers, replace checkpoints, promote ontology labels, or admit training from this receipt.

followup: Build a parity cohort with reviewed target labels and compare only normalized canonical classes; represent taxonomy abstention separately from a general class. Keep classifier promotion and training admission blocked until that cohort is independently approved.
